Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together.

 

The opportunity

  • Own growth in viral, KOL- and creator-referred new transacting users (NTUs). Set aggressive NTU targets backed by a credible growth model, then beat them. Build and scale sharing, referral, and creator systems that drive 10x, then 50x growth while hitting payback targets.

  • Build sharing people find useful. Create natural reasons to pass on product value, and referral programs with modeled payback incentives, and without relying on aggressive incentives to hit targets. Make both work for the sender, recipient, and business.

  • Own the audience-to-customer journey. Build and test paths from recommendations and creator audiences to product value and a first transaction. Partner with the teams that own onboarding and core product experiences on shared journeys.

  • Own Consumer features and updates for the KOL Platform. Set the Consumer roadmap, ship features and ongoing improvements, and make measurement and commercial tools trustworthy and easy to use. Work with the teams that own KOL and affiliate relationships.

  • Build creator tools across Kraken’s app and web. Help creators, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and power referrers invite their followers and turn their audiences into valuable new transacting customers. Understand their different motivations and build with core product teams.

  • Make acquisition economics work. Own acquisition cost and gross-margin payback against clear targets, including fully loaded incentive, partner, operating, and fraud costs. Use downstream retention and revenue to judge what deserves more investment.

  • Increase virality per new transacting user and per returning user. Test ways to improve send conversion, invites per sender, and invite-to-first-transaction conversion. Improve repeat sharing and loop speed, and prove the gains create incremental valuable new transacting customers.

  • Build measurement you can trust. Validate instrumentation, define hypotheses and guardrails, and run tests that can detect meaningful effects. Separate attributed activity from incremental growth, interpret uncertainty honestly, and check that gains persist as you scale.

 

What you bring

  • You’ve personally built a product, tool, feature, or experience that spread beyond its initial audience. You can explain why it spread, your contribution, and how it acquired valuable customers.

  • Repeated success beating acquisition targets through referrals, product virality, or creator-led growth. Show the baseline, target, result, timeframe, component rates you improved, and your personal contribution. Bring evidence the gains lasted.

  • Strong growth product sense. You understand sharing psychology and the different motivations of customers, creators, KOLs, and power referrers. You combine customer research, creative product instincts, and strong UX and copy to give people a reason to participate.

  • Analytical independence. You independently investigate behavior with SQL and product analytics, validate instrumentation, and build funnel, cohort, and growth models.

  • Experimentation and commercial judgment. You design reliable tests, interpret uncertainty honestly, and distinguish attribution from incremental growth. You understand acquisition cost and payback, including downstream retention, revenue, and fully loaded incentive and fraud costs.

  • Senior ownership and hands-on execution. You set strategy, make hard priority calls, align teams without relying on reporting lines, and deliver autonomously. You use AI and working prototypes to turn original ideas into experiences people can try.

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience building self-service creator or affiliate tools, revenue-share systems, or reliable partner payouts.

  • Consumer fintech, crypto, payments, or experience designing financial promotions and fraud controls.

  • Experience adapting growth journeys across markets, cultures, and regulatory environments.

 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Head of Legal

Europe or United States, remote first with offices available · Full-time · People · Reports to CEO

About DFNS

Finance is moving onchain. Stablecoins, tokenized deposits, securities and funds are changing how money and assets are issued, held and transferred. The destination is a financial system where any asset can be issued, moved and governed onchain with the controls regulated institutions require. That shift needs a new foundation. Just as core banking systems manage accounts and ledgers today, financial institutions need a platform to manage digital assets. DFNS is that platform. Today, we secure hundreds of billions of dollars in assets every month for more than 500 clients worldwide.

Why this role

We operate where fintech meets digital assets in a regulatory landscape that changes every quarter across EMEA, Americas and APAC. We sell to institutions whose own lawyers read every clause. You will be the legal leader of the company, owning commercial contracts, IP, employment, disputes and regulatory affairs and turning regulation into product requirements with our CPO rather than into reasons to say no. In year one you will put playbooks in place that let Sales close without a lawyer on every call, build the living regulatory map of the markets we serve and become the person regulators and partners expect to see across the table.

What you’ll do

  • Draft, negotiate and close commercial contracts (SaaS agreements, MSAs, NDAs, DPAs, partnership and vendor deals) with the playbooks and templates that let Sales move without you in every call.

  • Own regulatory affairs end to end, from MiCA, DORA, GDPR and AML to US state and federal frameworks, UK FCA, MAS and VARA, and maintain a living regulatory map of the markets we serve.

  • Translate regulatory requirements into product specifications with the CPO and product team, turning obligations into features and, where it fits, into advantage.

  • Lead engagement with regulators, industry bodies and policy stakeholders.

  • Build and run the IP strategy (trademarks, copyright, patents) with external IP counsel.

  • Advise the People team on employment contracts, policies and labor law in every country we hire in, sensitive matters and investigations included.

  • Manage disputes, claims and litigation, from pre-litigation strategy to settlement.

  • Run external counsel across jurisdictions for expertise, speed and cost.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • Admitted to practice law in France and the US

  • Substantial in-house experience at a growing technology company, across commercial contracts, regulatory, IP and employment matters.

  • Deep, hands-on regulatory affairs experience in fintech, digital assets, payments or financial services, with a real appetite for regulatory deep dives.

  • A record of drafting and negotiating complex B2B agreements with regulated counterparties.

  • Proven ability to turn legal and regulatory requirements into product and business inputs people can act on.

  • Employment law in France and at least one other jurisdiction where we hire, plus working knowledge of IP strategy and litigation management.

  • Fluent English and French, with the gravitas to sit across from regulators and operate at the executive level.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with GENIUS, MiCA, DORA or digital asset licensing processes.

  • Another major jurisdiction in depth (UK, Hong Kong, Singapore, UAE).

  • Other languages.

How we work

We are a distributed company headquartered in Paris. Our teams work from Europe, the US and Asia, with offices in New York, Geneva, Dubai, Singapore, Hong Kong and São Paulo. We write decisions down so they survive time zones. We hold our own work to the standards our clients are held to. We hire people who can own an outcome end to end and we give them the room to do it.

What we offer

A competitive base salary set by role and location, a bonus or variable plan where the role carries one and stock options vesting over four years. Healthcare, flexible vacation, parental leave and a one-time home technology allowance, with travel expenses covered. A MacBook and the equipment you need to do your best work. Remote first, with an office if you want one.

Base salary range: $200,000-300,000

Hiring process

We aim to complete the process in 2 weeks and we tell you where you stand after every step.

  1. Intro call with Co-CEO (30 minutes).

  2. Personality and cognitive assessments, completed on your own time (45 minutes).

  3. Focus interviews with the hiring panel in role-specific sessions (about 3 hours in total).

  4. Reference calls and background checks.

Equal opportunity

DFNS is an equal opportunity employer and considers every applicant based on ability and potential, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, tell us and we will arrange it.

descriptions.job-15ib24y:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

About the role

We're looking for a Blockchain Intelligence Analyst to operate as a high-judgment, high-autonomy individual contributor specializing in transnational criminal organisations. You will use blockchain analytics, open-source and closed-source intelligence, and cryptocurrency attribution to trace the proceeds of drug trafficking, identify the networks that move them, and produce intelligence that helps TRM and its partners disrupt illicit drug activity.

This is not a people-management role. We're looking for an experienced analyst who can independently lead complex investigations, develop high-confidence assessments, uncover novel attribution, and raise the team's tradecraft through technical expertise and example. This role will require proactive work with law enforcement partners, often picking up a stalled investigation, finding what was missed, and linking it to other cases.

You should be equally comfortable tracing funds across blockchains, identifying laundering and cash-out infrastructure, correlating on-chain and off-chain signals, and turning fragmented data into clear, defensible intelligence that enables partners to make informed operational decisions.

The impact you will have

  • Produce finished intelligence on transnational criminal organisations, vendors, facilitators and laundering pathways, including actor profiles, lead packages and attribution assessments suitable for investigative, executive and partner audiences.

  • Lead complex end-to-end blockchain investigations from initial seed indicators, such as addresses, transactions, exchange exposure and infrastructure leads, through to full attribution.

  • Trace illicit proceeds across multiple blockchains, bridges, mixers, peel chains and nested services, identifying controllers, counterparties and cash-out points, including OTC desks, ATM networks and cash-to-crypto services.

  • Correlate on-chain activity with OSINT, closed-source intelligence and off-chain identity or infrastructure signals to build a complete picture of how transnational criminal organisations operate and move value.

  • Own investigative work-streams from discovery through validation and written production, drafting intelligence that is source-cited, auditable and operationally useful.

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with law enforcement partners, so that our intelligence reflects real investigative tradecraft and gets used.

  • Help strengthen TRM's transnational criminal organisations coverage by contributing new attributions, refining investigative methodology and improving repeatable workflows.

  • Support briefings, partner engagements and capability-building sessions where tracing and attribution tradecraft must be explained clearly and credibly.

What success looks like

  • You generate meaningful attribution and investigative leads in cases where the answers are not obvious and the financial trail is deliberately obscured.

  • You consistently produce finished intelligence that partners trust and use.

  • Your work helps TRM and its partners move faster on high-priority narcotics activity without sacrificing rigor, auditability or defensibility.

  • You improve team capability by mentoring peers, refining tradecraft and strengthening repeatable workflows.

What we're looking for

  • Professional experience: 5+ years in blockchain intelligence, crypto investigations, financial-crime or narcotics investigations, threat intelligence, or a comparable senior analytical role.

  • Blockchain tracing expertise: deep hands-on experience tracing funds across multiple blockchains and through laundering or obfuscation techniques such as mixers, chain-hopping, bridges, peel chains and layered cash-out behavior.

  • Investigative tradecraft: demonstrated ability to independently run complex investigations and synthesize findings into clear written intelligence products, including assessments, lead packages, fund-flow analysis and attribution reporting.

  • Strong communication: especially the ability to turn technically complex findings into understandable, actionable intelligence for government and private-sector audiences.

  • Judgment and execution: sound judgment and curiosity, and the ability to operate in a fast-moving environment where outputs must still stand up to scrutiny.

  • AI fluency: experience using AI tools and large language models to accelerate research and augment analytical workflows, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and relevance.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in government, national security, law enforcement, or a mature private-sector investigations or threat intelligence program.

  • Familiarity with darknet markets, drug-trafficking networks, OTC and ATM laundering

  • Familiarity with OSINT and with combining blockchain activity with off-chain signals and adversary behavior.

  • Comfort with modern investigative tooling, including AI and structured data environments such as TRM, Maltego, Palantir or similar platforms.

About the Team

  • The team operates within TRM’s Blockchain Intelligence organization, alongside threat intelligence analysts, on-chain investigators, and law enforcement partners

  • Blockchain Intelligence Analysts are the operational core, converting on-chain tracing and off-chain intelligence into attribution and actionable leads on transnational criminal organizations

  • Distributed team with an async-first approach via Slack and Notion, plus structured syncs for alignment

  • High autonomy, high standards, low bureaucracy. You’ll work directly with analysts, engineers, and customers who depend on your output

 

Team Operating Rhythms

  • Weekly team syncs to align on priorities and review active casework

  • Regular async updates via Slack on active investigations, attribution work, and leads in flight

  • Primary time zone overlap: Working hours should overlap with both UK and US business hours

  • All output documented in Notion and TRM’s investigative tools

  • Surge availability expected when partners need a fast turnaround

 

Join Our Mission

We seek people whose work matters, who build with speed and rigor, and who take pride in protecting others through their craft. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, apply anyway.

 

Build to protect civilization. Let’s do it together.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

  • If the business moves toward a local CS team in the future, help scope, plan, and build this function from the ground up.

Experience & Industry Knowledge

  • 5+ years of experience in customer operations, customer experience, or support leadership, ideally within fintech, crypto, or financial services.

  • Experience working with or leading offshore support teams in a high-growth or regulated environment.

  • Strong leadership and coaching ability, with a focus on raising offshore team performance without direct line management.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills — ability to work across compliance, product, marketing, and support teams.

  • Map accounts and coordinate effective meetings with the appropriate internal and external stakeholders to deepen and expand customer relationships.
  • Navigate opportunities of varying size and complexity, balancing velocity across the broader Commercial segment with a highly consultative approach for high-profile SMB accounts.

  • Lead and contribute to team projects that develop and refine our sales processes and help shape Stripe’s sales culture.

  • Experience managing a varied portfolio and progressing opportunities with different levels of size, complexity, and sales-cycle length.
  • Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple products.
  • Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units within complex organisations.

About the Role:

The ideal candidate will be a strong sourcer and recruiter who can quickly understand hiring needs, identify high-quality candidates, drive outreach, and efficiently schedule interviews. You will partner closely with hiring managers and the broader Talent Acquisition team to keep searches moving and deliver an exceptional candidate experience.

  • Build targeted candidate pipelines through proactive sourcing and outreach.
  • Conduct initial candidate screens and assess candidates against role requirements.

  • Maintain accurate candidate activity, notes, and pipeline data in Greenhouse.
  • Support recruiting across a range of functions as business needs evolve.

Candidate & Interview Coordination:

  • Own interview scheduling and coordination across multiple searches and stakeholders.
  • Ensure candidates receive a timely, organized, and positive interview experience.
  • Coordinate with hiring managers and interviewers to keep processes moving efficiently.
  • Communicate with candidates throughout the recruiting process and provide timely updates.
  • Support offer and closing processes as needed.

What We’re Looking For:

Experience & Qualifications:

  • 2-10 years of recruiting experience, preferably within a fast-paced technology, fintech, financial services, or high-growth environment.
  • Strong sourcing skills with demonstrated ability to identify and engage qualified candidates.
  • Strong ability to manage interview scheduling and coordination across multiple searches.
  • Experience recruiting for G&A functions such as Finance, Legal, People, Operations, Compliance, and other corporate teams.
  • Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter, Greenhouse, Juicebox, or similar recruiting and ATS platforms.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and follow-through.

Leadership & Operating Style:

  • Highly proactive, resourceful, and comfortable working independently.
  • Strong sense of urgency and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Excellent relationship builder who can work effectively with candidates and hiring managers.
  • Detail-oriented and disciplined in managing recruiting processes.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced and changing environment.
  • Team-oriented with a strong commitment to delivering an exceptional candidate experience.
  • Passionate about recruiting and building high-performing teams.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience recruiting within fintech, financial services, crypto, or digital assets.
  • Experience supporting high-volume or multiple concurrent searches.
  • Experience recruiting for senior-level G&A positions.
  • Experience working in Greenhouse.
  • Existing sourcing strategies and strong ability to build pipelines quickly.

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.

Pay Transparency Notice: Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $50 - $75 USD an hour. 

Here are some of the benefits* of working at BitGo:

  • Free custom lunches, dinners and snacks 
  • Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs
  • Great colleagues and inspiring startup environment

*Benefits may vary based on location 

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you’ll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.

Pluralis Research works on Protocol Learning: training and serving large models in a fully decentralized way on small consumer-grade devices connected via the internet. Despite being dismissed as infeasible, we have made significant advances on this problem, most recently Agora, a permissionless run that pretrained an 8B model from scratch on consumer GPUs spread over the internet, with no single participant ever holding the full weights (tech report). While many of the core research problems have been solved, Protocol Learning unlocks a series of new challenges. For the mission in full, read A Third Path: Protocol Learning.

This setting breaks nearly every assumption of datacenter training: communication-efficient training across different parallelism axes, fault tolerance as nodes join and drop mid-run, heterogeneous compute and networks, and robustness to malicious participants. Our published methods include Subspace Networks, Factored Gossip DiLoCo, AsyncMesh, and Sentinel.

As a Research Scientist you'll build the training system that takes Protocol Learning from the 8B run to frontier scale: large models on heterogeneous hardware, in physically different regions, connected by ordinary internet.

Key Responsibilities

  • Distributed pretraining: Implement and optimize model-parallel training. Data, pipeline, and tensor parallelism for large models on heterogeneous GPUs under low-bandwidth, high-latency links.

  • Performance optimization: Implement techniques that reduce communication overhead while maintaining model convergence in challenging network environments.

  • Elasticity and fault tolerance: Make runs survive node churn. Robust checkpointing, state synchronization, and recovery as participants join and leave.

  • Run instrumentation: Build the monitoring that shows throughput, bottlenecks, and model quality across hundreds of devices.

What We're Looking For

  • Hands-on distributed training (required): You've trained models across many devices in PyTorch with FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron, or your own implementation. You understand data, tensor, and pipeline parallelism.

  • Own the threat model: You enumerate what a malicious or careless worker can do across pre-training, post-training, and inference — training disruption and denial-of-service, free-riding, model poisoning and backdoors, data extraction from gradients and activations, reputation and reward manipulation — and you keep that model current as the network grows.

  • Design and calibrate the tests: You build statistical verification methods with stated error rates, tune them with rigorous benchmarks, and keep false positives and false negatives controlled across heterogeneous hardware, including different GPUs and Macs.
